typography.headingCharacter: Very heavy wide squarish grotesque, all-caps, flat horizontal terminals, squared bowls on E/G/J, near-zero tracking so letters almost touch, tight leading around 0.9
typography.bodyCharacter: Neutral humanist sans, regular weight, normal tracking, generous ~1.5 leading, short measure of roughly 40 characters, set in grey below the headline

composition.structure: Full-bleed dark canvas; a left text rail carries eyebrow, display headline, copy and two buttons, with the nav column stacked vertically beside the logo. The globe bleeds off the top-right and is cropped by the frame.

spacing.rhythm: Large empty voids left and below the hero; tight inside groups (headline lines nearly collide, nav items on a short even step), with a wide gap between headline block and button row

surfaceTreatment.finish: Matte black with starfield grain and atmospheric bloom: orange rim-light along the top limb, cold blue halo below, landmasses drawn as fine white dot clusters. The one opaque white card sits flat on it

imagery.treatment: A particle globe of fine white dots, cropped hard by the right and top edges, ringed by orange rim-glow and blue atmosphere, overlaid with thin orange arc paths and small black rectangular pins with orange markers

motion.character: Colour, border and transform transitions at 0.35-0.4s ease; primary button hover shifts colour, border and a filter glow; an 8s linear marquee on the ticker and a 3s cubic-bezier pulse on the globe markers loop forever
motion.choreography: Lenis smooth scroll over a 31-viewport page: 399 elements travel at rates other than the scroll itself, so nearly every layer parallaxes. Reveals fade in at several different depths rather than as one group; 60 elements loop with no input at all

philosophy.text: This design treats the viewport as a window onto an operating system rather than a page: the globe is not decoration but the subject, cropped off two edges so it reads as larger than the frame and continuing beyond it. Everything else is subordinated to that — the type sits in flat black negative space on the left, the navigation is a plain stacked list with no chrome, and the only opaque surface in the composition is the consent card. Colour is rationed to a single orange that appears identically as the planet's rim-light, the route arcs and the map pins, tying interface and render into one object. The squared techno lettering on labels and the black-box pins borrow the register of a tracking console, so the ambient pulsing and the sequenced parallax read as live telemetry rather than as flourish. What it trades away is hierarchy at rest — the page depends on continuous motion across a 31-viewport scroll, and keeps that motion even under reduced-motion.

build.techniques: Dotted globe as instanced points sampled from a landmass mask, with additive rim/atmosphere shaders for the orange limb and blue halo; great-circle arc curves with animated draw and pulsing markers; HTML pin labels projected from 3D positions; ScrollTrigger layering elements at differing scroll rates over Lenis; CSS marquee for the ticker.
